topography.project_purpose: Exactly is a decentralized fixed- and variable-rate lending/credit protocol that enables users to supply and borrow assets. It includes the EXA governance token and staking mechanisms for rewards and protocol security.
topography.relationship_narrative: Lending Markets rely on Auditor contracts for risk assessment and InterestRateModel for rate calculations, while Governance and Staking contracts manage EXA token incentives and protocol parameters. Security contracts like Firewall and TimelockController provide shared access control and transaction validation across all families.
